### Make AKR MCP handshake with current clients and fix collated papercuts

`proposed` · `@akr.work.mcp-handshake-and-collated-papercuts/1`

Reproduce and eliminate sister-project AKR MCP failed-to-connect reports: Grok and similar clients negotiate protocol 2025-06-18 and/or Content-Length framing, after which akr-mcp currently answers 2024-11-05 over NDJSON-only and the host attaches with zero tools. Also absorb the 2026-08-14 collated papercuts that are still live: named get slots, start namespaces, start default budget, change status alias, empty-repo commit message, --from slot-list example, write-time enum validation, and SQLite busy-timeout for concurrent MCP sessions.

### Give the agent scratch directory a lifecycle

`proposed` · `@akr.work.scratch-lifecycle/1`

Give `.agent/scratch/` a lifecycle, so the one disposable directory nothing empties
on its own stops growing until a person clears it by hand.

Measurement and reporting, not deletion by default: `akr check` prints what is there
as a build fact, `knowledge.start` says the same at orientation, and
`akr check --scratch-clean` is the opt-in gate. `akr scratch prune` removes unkept
entries by age and `akr scratch keep` protects one with a reason, so an agent can
tidy up at the end of a session without being able to delete what the next session
was told to expect. See D-036.
